thanks.en:
Dear {name}, thank you so much! We have received {paid} of your pledge of {amount} for {event}.
God bless you.
thanks.lg:
Webale nnyo {name}! Tufunye {paid} ku bweyamo bwo obwa {amount} eri {event}.
Katonda akuwe omukisa.
thanks.sw:
Mpendwa {name}, asante sana! Tumepokea {paid} kati ya ahadi yako ya {amount} kwa {event}.
Mungu akubariki.

confirmation.en:
Payment received: {payment} from {name} for {event} ({how}).
Paid so far {paid} of {amount}; balance {balance}.
Thank you!
confirmation.lg:
Tufunye {payment} okuva ewa {name} eri {event} ({how}).
Osasudde {paid} ku {amount}; osigazza {balance}.
Webale nnyo!
confirmation.sw:
Malipo yamepokelewa: {payment} kutoka kwa {name} kwa {event} ({how}).
Umelipa {paid} kati ya {amount}; bado {balance}.
Asante!

meeting.en:
Dear {name}, the {event} committee meets {meeting_when} at {meeting_where}.
You are kindly requested to attend. Thank you.
meeting.lg:
Gyebale ko {name}, olukiiko lwa {event} lujja kutuula {meeting_when} e {meeting_where}.
Tukusaba obeewo. Webale.
meeting.sw:
Mpendwa {name}, kamati ya {event} itakutana {meeting_when} katika {meeting_where}.
Unaombwa kuhudhuria. Asante.

templates.name: Kukyala (visit before the introduction)
templates.description: The groom's small party visits the bride's family with the ssenga to ask for the introduction date. Gifts, a letter for the father and a light meal.

items.name: Envelope with the letter for the bride's father
Gift basket: sugar, salt, soap, cooking oil
Car hire and fuel for the visiting party

templates.name: Kwanjula (Buganda introduction)
templates.description: The introduction at the bride's home: the omutwalo and envelopes, the bintu (gifts), outfits for the delegation, a spokesman and a meal for about 300 guests.

items.name: Baskets and wrapping for the gifts
Kanzu and coat for the groom
Gomesi for the women of the delegation

templates.name: Kuhingira (Ankole and Kiga give-away)
templates.description: The bride's family gives her away: the bride price in cows and goats, gifts for the parents and aunt, local brew and a big meal for about 400 guests.

items.name: Kanzu and coat for the bride's father

templates.name: Nyom (Acholi and Lango traditional marriage)
templates.description: The traditional marriage in the north: bride wealth in cows and goats as the clans agree (the Ker Kwaro Acholi by-law guides the amounts), gifts for the elders, local brew and a feast.

items.name: Goats for the uncle, the paternal aunt and the new home
Suit or kanzu for the bride's father
Cloth, saucepans and basins for the bride's mother

templates.name: Catholic church wedding
templates.description: A parish wedding (with the three months of instruction) and a reception for about 300 guests: tents, a buffet, cake, music and pictures.

templates.name: Anglican wedding (Church of Uganda)
templates.description: A Church of Uganda wedding (cathedral or parish fees, counselling, the choir and Mothers' Union) and a reception for about 300 guests.

templates.name: Pentecostal (born-again) wedding
templates.description: A born-again church wedding with counselling and the worship team, and an alcohol-free reception for about 250 guests (more sodas and juice).

templates.name: Nikah and Walima (Muslim wedding)
templates.description: The nikah at the mosque (mahr, the imam and the certificate) and the walima feast for about 300 guests: a halal cow, pilau, sodas and juice, qaswida.

items.name: Kanzu and coat for the bride's father
Hijab and busuuti for the aunts
Car for the couple (with driver and fuel)

templates.name: Civil wedding (registrar)
templates.description: A marriage before the registrar (notice, ceremony and certificate, now with NIRA) with two witnesses and a small lunch for about 30 people.

templates.name: Introduction and wedding together
templates.description: The introduction and the church wedding on one weekend with one venue and one tent: the bride price and gifts, church fees, outfit changes and a meal for about 400 guests.

items.name: Kanzu and coat for the bride's father
Foodstuffs: sugar, salt, rice, oil, soap
Kanzu, coat and suit for the groom

templates.name: Simple village wedding
templates.description: A small, affordable wedding at the local church and home: hired chairs and tents, a local buffet, a hired gown and a village photographer, about 150 guests.

templates.name: Kampala hotel wedding (mid-range)
templates.description: A reception in a mid-range Kampala hotel for about 250 guests: the hotel's per-guest package (buffet, hall, basic decor), corkage, cake, MC, DJ and pictures.

templates.name: Garden wedding
templates.description: A reception in a hired garden for about 300 guests: tents, generator, toilets and security, a full decor package, a live band and a buffet.

templates.name: Luxury wedding
templates.description: A five-star celebration for about 500 guests: hotel plates, designer decor, a live band, a luxury car fleet, an imported gown, cinematic video, a planner and a honeymoon.

items.name: Hotel rooms for family from upcountry

templates.name: Send-off party (kasiki)
templates.description: The bride's family and friends see her off before the wedding: a small tent, a buffet, music, a cake, gifts for her new home and the ssenga's counsel. About 120 guests.

items.name: Gifts for her new home (kitchen set, basket)

templates.name: Graduation party
templates.description: A home party after the graduation: a tent and chairs, a buffet, a cake, an MC and DJ and a photo shoot in the gown. About 100 guests.

templates.name: Fundraiser (church, school fees or medical bill)
templates.description: A fundraising drive with a launch gathering: the amount to raise (edit it to your target), refreshments, pledge cards, a banner, sound and MC. About 150 guests.

items.name: Amount to raise (edit to your target)
Transport and thanks for the guest of honour
